description: Search a folder and everything below it by name, path and document text. Results come from an index on the workspace VM, so they can lag the drive; meta.index says how far behind it is. Paths with any segment starting with "." and derived folders such as node_modules are never indexed, so no result does not mean no file. Terms of two letters or more match by word prefix; a one-letter term matches that whole word only. "voice" does not find "invoice". Text is read only from pdf, docx, pptx, xlsx, md, txt, csv and html files.

ext.description: File extensions to keep, lowercase and without the dot (pdf, docx). Excludes folders.

search.description: Words to match by prefix. Empty lists the newest files first.

sort.description: Defaults to relevance for a query and modified for an empty one.

name: file_search
